 #What is Zee?

 **Zee** is a Teams-based AI agent for the ZebraAI community that provides first‑line, always‑on support inside Microsoft Teams and Copilot. It answers common ZebraAI questions by pulling from approved internal sources such as the ZebraAI wiki and relevant historical Teams discussions, so users can get quick, consistent answers without leaving their flow of work.

View the Zee intro video, here: [Zee Agent Intro.mp4](https://microsoftapc.sharepoint.com/:v:/t/ZebraAI/IQCqR1cEgR47RJP2rdaBIoFpAU8vpAOo8C72Aqmk5-VGyAg?e=7w1vtq&isSPOFile=1&%3D&sdata=STZ3Tm5GL3daK3RscEU1Zkk5QUVBTm9ETWVVS3V0eitmV0JDVzF6YjhVbz0%3D&ovuser=72f988bf-86f1-41af-91ab-2d7cd011db47%2Cv-matthewhar%40microsoft.com)

**The problems it solves:**
*   ZebraAI knowledge is spread across wikis and Teams threads, making it time‑consuming to find answers.
*   Users often rely on manual, human follow‑ups for basic or repeat questions.
*   Context switching slows down onboarding and day‑to‑day productivity.
*   It works 24/7, alleviating wait times for human support during off-hours.

**Zee v1 currently does not:**
*   Answer experiment‑level questions
*   Provide reporting or analytics data
*   Replace human support for advanced or case‑specific issues
*   Act as a system of record or execution tool

#How can I use Zee in the General Channel?
 

1.  Navigate to the **ZebraAI General** Teams channel, [here](https://teams.microsoft.com/l/channel/19%3A1Pvl3cRXmwYrC0nv1jFV7NZj6qQLGbgv0EeGvg6swqc1%40thread.tacv2/General?groupId=af998ff3-0fad-4654-b368-5249e20ada9e&tenantId=72f988bf-86f1-41af-91ab-2d7cd011db47).
2.  Ask your question directly in the channel (just as you would ask a person).
3.  ZEE will respond in the thread with an answer based on available ZebraAI knowledge.
No special commands or mentions are required—ZEE monitors the channel and replies where appropriate.
